t2.title: University education be free for all students
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should university education be free for all students?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
The cost of university education has become a significant barrier for many students. I strongly believe education should be free to ensure equal opportunities for all.

Firstly, free education promotes social equality. Currently, students from wealthy families have easier access to higher education, while talented individuals from lower-income backgrounds often cannot afford tuition fees. Free universities would allow everyone to develop their potential.

Secondly, student debt has reached alarming levels. Many graduates spend decades repaying loans, delaying major life decisions like buying homes or starting families. Removing this burden would benefit both individuals and the economy.

Critics argue that free education is too expensive for governments. However, countries like Germany and Norway offer free university education successfully. The long-term benefits of a more educated workforce outweigh the costs.

Furthermore, increased corporate taxation and reduced military spending could fund free education without significantly burdening taxpayers.

In conclusion, free university education would create a fairer society and produce more skilled professionals. Investment in education is investment in our future.

Dear SnapStudio Team,

Thank you for the photoshoot session. Overall, it was a positive experience, but there are a few things I wanted to mention.

The photographer was professional and made me feel comfortable. However, I think the lighting could have been better in some shots. Some of the photos were a bit too dark. The studio facilities were good, clean and well-equipped.

t2.sampleB2: Should University Be Free for Everyone? Imagine a bright student turning down their dream course simply because they can't afford it. Sadly, this happens all the time — which is why I firmly believe university education should be free for all. First and foremost, free education levels the playing field. When money is taken out of the equation, talented young people from every background get a fair shot at success, rather than only those whose parents can foot the bill. Surely that makes for a fairer society. What's more, graduates today are drowning in debt. Many spend years paying off loans instead of buying homes or starting businesses — major milestones that end up on hold for a decade. Scrapping tuition fees would lift that weight and give the whole economy a boost. Of course, critics point out that free education costs the state a fortune. Yet countries such as Germany and Norway manage it perfectly well, and a well-educated workforce pays off in the long run through higher productivity and tax revenue. All things considered, free university education is an investment worth making. After all, educating our young people today means building a brighter tomorrow for everyone.
t2.uzSample:
Universitet taʼlimi narxi koʻplab talabalar uchun jiddiy toʻsiq boʻlib qoldi. Men barcha uchun teng imkoniyatlarni taʼminlash uchun taʼlim bepul boʻlishi kerak, deb qatʼiy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, bepul taʼlim ijtimoiy tenglikni ragʻbatlantiradi. Hozirda boy oilalardan chiqqan talabalar oliy taʼlimga osonroq erishadilar, kam daromadli oilalardan chiqqan isteʼdodli shaxslar esa koʻpincha oʻqish uchun toʻlovlarni toʻlashga qurbi yetmaydi. Bepul universitetlar har bir kishiga oʻz salohiyatini rivojlantirishga imkon beradi.

Ikkinchidan, talabalarning qarzlari xavotirli darajaga yetdi. Koʻpgina bitiruvchilar kreditlarni toʻlash uchun oʻnlab yillar sarflaydilar, uy sotib olish yoki oila qurish kabi muhim hayotiy qarorlarni kechiktiradilar. Bu yukni olib tashlash ham shaxslarga, ham iqtisodiyotga foyda keltiradi.

Tanqidchilarning taʼkidlashicha, bepul taʼlim hukumatlar uchun juda qimmatga tushadi. Biroq, Germaniya va Norvegiya kabi davlatlar bepul universitet taʼlimini muvaffaqiyatli taklif qilmoqda. Maʼlumotli ishchi kuchining uzoq muddatli foydalari xarajatlardan ustun turadi.

Bundan tashqari, korporativ soliqni oshirish va harbiy xarajatlarni kamaytirish soliq toʻlovchilarga sezilarli darajada yuklamasdan bepul taʼlimni moliyalashtirishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, bepul universitet taʼlimi yanada adolatli jamiyatni yaratadi va koʻproq malakali mutaxassislarni yetishtiradi. Taʼlimga sarmoya kiritish — bu kelajagimizga sarmoya kiritishdir.

t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli SnapStudio jamoasi,

Fotosessiya uchun rahmat. Umuman olganda, bu ijobiy tajriba bo'ldi, lekin men aytmoqchi bo'lgan bir nechta narsalar bor.

Fotograf professional edi va o'zimni qulay his qilishimga yordam berdi. Biroq, menimcha, ba'zi kadrlarda yorug'lik yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin edi. Ba'zi fotosuratlar biroz qorong'i edi. Studiya jihozlari yaxshi, toza va yaxshi jihozlangan edi.

Men yakuniy tasvirlardan asosan xursand bo'ldim, lekin ba'zi retushlar ularni yaxshilashi mumkin edi. Ehtimol, turli retush paketlarini taklif qilish yaxshi fikr bo'lar edi. Shuningdek, menimcha, nashrlarni o'z ichiga olgan paket ba'zi mijozlar uchun jozibali bo'ladi.

Xizmat uchun yana bir bor rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
Ozoda Nazarova
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli SnapStudio jamoasi,

Men yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan fotosessiya tajribam bo'yicha fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Sizning jamoangizning professionalligi va samaradorligini qadrlasam ham, takomillashtirish bo'yicha ba'zi takliflarim bor.

Fotograf mohir edi va men qadrlagan xotirjam muhit yaratdi. Biroq, pozalar bo'yicha berilgan yo'nalishlar aniqroq bo'lishi mumkin edi, deb his qildim. Ba'zi pozalar g'ayritabiiy tuyuldi va menimcha, ko'proq yo'l-yo'riq yaxshiroq tasvirlarga olib kelgan bo'lardi. Studiya sharoitlari yaxshi saqlangan va qulay muhitni ta'minlagan.

Yakuniy tasvirlarga kelsak, men umuman mamnun bo'ldim, garchi tahrirlash uslubi mening didimga to'liq mos kelmasa ham. Ehtimol, mijozlarga tahrirlash uslubini tanlash imkoniyatini (masalan, tabiiy, yuqori moda) taklif qilish mijozlar ehtiyojini qondirishni yaxshilashi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, kutilayotgan natijalar va uslubiy afzalliklarni muhokama qilish uchun suratga olishdan oldin maslahatlashuvni o'z ichiga olgan paket juda foydali bo'ladi.

Fikr-mulohazalarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun tashakkur. Ushbu takliflarni amalga oshirish sizning xizmatingiz sifatini yanada oshirishi mumkin, deb hisoblayman.

Hurmat bilan,
Ozoda Nazarova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the photography studio. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear SnapStudio Team, Thank you for reaching out about my recent photography session. I am extremely happy with the results. Your photographer was incredibly professional and made everyone feel comfortable. The studio facilities were modern and the variety of backdrops was impressive. The final images exceeded my expectations – they captured our personalities perfectly. However, I have a few suggestions. The editing turnaround time was longer than expected. I would appreciate faster delivery or at least a preview of unedited photos while waiting. Additionally, I would love if you offered outdoor photography packages at scenic locations. A mini-session option at lower prices would also attract more customers. Overall, the experience was memorable and I will certainly recommend SnapStudio to friends. Yours sincerely, Ozoda Nazarova

Hi SnapStudio,

Photo good. I like photo. Studio is ok. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hi SnapStudio,

Thank you for the photos. I like them. The photographer was nice and the studio was good. But the photos took a long time. I think you need to be faster. And maybe you can have more photos outside? Because I like outside photos. Thanks!

t12.sampleB1:
Dear SnapStudio Team,

Thank you for your email. I wanted to tell you about my photoshoot. I think the photographer was very good and the studio was nice and clean. I really liked the photos, they look great!

However, I think it took a long time to get the finished photos. Maybe you could make it faster? Also, I think it would be good if you had some cheaper packages, because the prices are a bit high. For example, maybe a shorter session for less money?

Overall, I was happy with the experience and I would recommend you to other people.

Thanks,

Ozoda Nazarova
t12.sampleB2: Dear SnapStudio Team, Thank you for getting in touch regarding my recent photography session. I am delighted to share some feedback. On the whole, I was thoroughly impressed. Your photographer was warm and professional, and put the whole family at ease within minutes. The studio itself was spotless, and the range of backdrops gave us plenty of choice. The final images genuinely exceeded my expectations. That said, I do have one suggestion. The editing took a fortnight, which felt rather long. A quicker turnaround, or a few unedited previews in the meantime, would make a real difference. I would also love to see outdoor packages at scenic spots — I'm sure they would prove popular. All in all, it was a memorable experience, and I will happily recommend you to friends and family. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev

Biroq, mening bir nechta takliflarim bor. Tahrirlashning bajarilish muddati kutilganidan uzoqroq edi. Tezroq yetkazib berish yoki hech bo'lmaganda kutish vaqtida tahrirlanmagan fotosuratlarning oldindan ko'rinishini taqdim etsangiz, minnatdor bo'lardim.

Bundan tashqari, agar siz manzarali joylarda ochiq havoda fotosessiya paketlarini taklif qilsangiz, juda xursand bo'lardim. Arzonroq narxlarda mini-sessiya varianti ham ko'proq mijozlarni jalb qiladi.

Hurmat bilan,
